authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4368 grāma expressly gives Bshk lām and L./P. girā̃/grā̃ village. These forms fit the village family; the final p in lāmp needs a local transcription/phonetic account. Reviewed comparison: awan girā̃ “village” (f_x5oglvn3ql7qc). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
